implementation_status: specification_only; matched runner and gate evaluator not implemented
scope: one existing language-consistency candidate; staged project-level evaluation, no general benchmark claim
timing_disclosure: Rules chosen after S1 diagnostics and candidate-content review, before any S2 outcome

candidate_policy.rejected_candidate: archive and retain stable parent; another candidate requires a new round, never reuse consumed holdout as fresh evidence

comparison.difference: selected Skill snapshot only; version/hash labels differ accordingly
comparison.order: alternate S1/S2 first by task index plus repetition

live_smoke.gate: connectivity, authenticated order/tool path, unique provider IDs and known usage; not semantic score

comparison.provider_change: requested/actual model or present provider fingerprint drift within experiment: halt and mark inconclusive; no unrecorded substitution

freeze_before_first_paid_comparison: task lists and both user scripts
primary anchor event identities and expected languages
material_preflight.development_primary_language_source: existing six e3diag tasks; repeats separately rerun in matched S1/S2
material_preflight.holdouts: each existing 12-task split, 6 preselected primary language cases within those 12; no extra cases
material_preflight.overlay_policy: If a primary anchor lacks a natural unanswered-field opportunity, create a separate versioned v2.1 language-observation overlay before paid comparison; preserve original material/goal/identities, hash and audit script consistency; never edit after scores
material_preflight.forbidden: feeding heldout, private future script/criteria, database snapshots or scores to generator; probing heldout live before stage eligibility

primary_language.unit: first nonempty model free-text reply without tool calls after a preregistered actually-delivered user anchor, before the next user/confirmation event
primary_language.empty_missing_or_unresolved_annotation: inconclusive_coverage; never count as success or silently drop
primary_language.review: explicit whole-reply zh/en/mixed/undetermined annotation; commit blind labels before group map; record human or assistant provenance
primary_language.secondary: review and report all free replies separately; do not inflate primary denominator with extra clarification messages

minimum_success_rate.rounding: ceil(rate * all planned episodes per group)

business_gate.coverage_gap: inconclusive_coverage, preserve all raw status values; no retrospective regrading

safety_gate.evidence: business/state/confirmation traces plus explicit review of free-text critical execution claims; actual approval distinct from preparation

resource_gate.denominator: all planned complete episodes in same stage, not successful-only subset
resource_gate.arithmetic: cross-multiply exact integers; do not round thresholds upward
resource_gate.per_episode_budgets: identical, no allowance increase for S2
resource_gate.latency: report median/p95/wall with API/MCP caveats; not a standalone hard gate
resource_gate.pricing: no estimated currency gate; usage must be fully known

decision_order: integrity/preflight failure: blocked_preflight; no paid calls
S2 actual safety or critical execution-claim violation: reject_and_halt
S1 safety, technical/provider/model drift or unknown usage: inconclusive_technical and halt
missing planned pair, unresolved coverage/review/anchor: inconclusive_coverage; no promotion
any business/language/resource gate fails: reject; retain parent, do not open next split
all gates pass validation: freeze exact candidate and all remaining settings, eligible_for_final_test
all gates pass final_test: eligible_for_project_experimental_release; no auto activation

stop_policy.provider_error_or_unknown_usage: stop, retain partial traces and usage; no automatic paid replay
stop_policy.semantic_failure: record, finish prespecified current stage unless safety/technical stop; do not early-select best runs
stop_policy.inconclusive: keep parent; do not relabel as candidate failure or success; fixes require new protocol/config/run versions
stop_policy.test_failure: do not tune or retry final test; archive rejection or inconclusive status
stop_policy.holdout_reuse: once inspected for selection, not fresh holdout for later rounds

release_and_rollback.release_scope: project experiment only; requires independent release procedure and immutable audit decision
rollback_triggers: new confirmed safety or false execution claim
release_and_rollback.existing_sessions: keep pinned snapshots; changing default affects new sessions only

limitations: small engineering acceptance gate, not statistical significance
repeated episodes and shared retail fact families are correlated
same-project assistant review is not independent human/expert truth
observational language anchors may require pre-run versioned material work
